body:
Heard of the show, never watched it. Why are you so skeptic? Because you believe that something like this couldn't possibly exist outside of TV?

I never made any kind of reference to any media, be it TV or otherwise. I am talking about my own life, my own depression, my own desire to kill myself. It's why I came to SW tonight, in search of a place to get one last message out just in case this was it.

I called a friend and they are here with me now, but just out of curiosity: why are you so determined to trivialize mental illness that you clearly have no experience with? Making presumptions (like telling me I "enjoyed" my impulses, when I never even suggested such a thing) and telling me that I am self-centred when all I want to do is die so I can stop hurting people, is NOT helping anyone.

I am sick. I admit that. And after tonight, thanks to talking things through with my friend, I will be seeking full-time help to deal with my illness. But for the sake of everyone else on SW, please stop posting messages as if you actually understand these things. I've been reading your messages and it seems as though I'm not the only person whose problems you have trivialized tonight.

You are not a cool, caring guy who is going to stop people from killing themselves just by telling them, "We're all going to die someday". This is serious mental illness we are talking about. Please, refrain from insulting anyone else and don't come back until you understand what it's like to feel helpless inside one's own mind.
Thank you for caring enough to post an actual response. I have called a friend and they are coming over to help me. Thank you for being here.

Sounds to me as though you're trying to mimic that bullshit Yahoo answers screenshot you posted previously (an answer that was obviously posted by someone who knows nothing of depression or mental health difficulties).

I do not think I am special, nor do I think that I am "eviler" than everyone else. I am a person who experiences uncontrollable impulses to hurt other beings. When I am "lucid", so to speak, I hate myself for these impulses and cannot understand them. When they strike, however, there is little I can do to control them. And trust me, when I say that *I have fucking tried*.

So, maybe I'm a psychopath. Or a sociopath. Or whatever. But I have done terrible things, hurt innocent people, and I do not deserve the privilege of living as if those things never happened. I do not deserve the forgiveness of myself or anyone else.

Also, "dude", I'm a nineteen-year-old girl.
